reuse.why: Uses the existing LinkAccountBaseParams and BankSyncProviders types and wraps the existing provider link functions instead of rewriting them; the check could have joined the existing accounts/link.ts helpers.

duplication.why: The uniqueness check is written once and applied to all five link handlers through one wrapper; only the per-provider account-id accessor varies.

placement.why: Applying the guard at handler registration keeps provider functions untouched, though the rule lives in app.ts rather than beside findOrCreateBank in link.ts, and a direct internal call to a linkXAccount function would skip it.

scope.why: Only the guard, its wiring and a focused test file.

maintainability.why: A small higher-order wrapper is easy to own and a new provider only needs one registration line, but enforcing the rule at registration rather than inside the link path is slightly indirect.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; every link handler goes through withBankAccountLinkCheck.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked, applied to every *-accounts-link handler via withBankAccountLinkCheck in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts.
